plugin.name: Animation
plugin.description: Make films of the model: keyframes on groups, materials, cameras, lights and the sun, a timeline with a dope sheet and a graph editor, camera moves, paths, look-at, shots – rendered as a video or PNG images at a fixed frame rate.

panel.title: Animation
panel.selectHint: Select a group or component to animate it – its values become keys at the frame shown.
panel.pathHint: A path is a group that holds only lines – draw them with the Line or Arc tool and make them a group.
panel.parentHint: A group inside another one moves with it – animate the outer one for the whole, the inner ones for their parts.
panel.addCameraHint: A new camera where the view is now, keyed at this frame
panel.keyCameraHint: Keys the camera where the view is now
panel.noCameras: No camera yet – the film is seen through the view as it is.
panel.addShotHint: From this frame on the film is seen through the next camera
panel.materialHint: Every face with the material changes – its opacity shows on parts made mostly of it.

basic.keySteps:
1. Select a group and go to a frame in the timeline.
2. Put it where it should be (Move, Rotate, Scale).
3. Press I – a key. Go to a later frame, move it again, press I again.
basic.selectFirst: Select a group or component first.
basic.notKeyed: Moved but not keyed yet – press I, or it jumps back when the frame changes.
basic.recipesHint: From the frame shown – change them later in the timeline.
basic.noPath: No path yet (a group of lines)
basic.clear: Remove the animation of the selection
basic.more: Cameras, shots, lights, the sun, curves and every value:

timeline.keyHint: Keys the selected groups where they are – the camera when nothing is selected (I)
timeline.autoKeyHint: Every move, turn or scale of a group becomes a key at the frame shown
timeline.lookThroughHint: The 3D view looks through the camera of the shot at this frame
timeline.fitHint: Shows the whole scene from start to end
timeline.resize: Drag to make it taller or lower
timeline.empty: Nothing animated yet. Select a group and press I – or choose a ready-made movement in the Animation panel.

graph.empty: Tick channels on the left – or select an animated group.

field.key: Key this value at this frame
field.unkey: Remove the key at this frame

sun.title: Sun
sun.hint: The hour moves the sun across the sky (the model's month), daylight dims it – for sunsets and nights.

light.hereHint: A spot at the eye, shining at the target – a lamp above the target

dolly.name: Fly closer
dolly.hint: from the view towards the model

render.title: Film
render.overlay: With the drawing over the view (labels, other plugins)
render.noCamera: No camera yet: the film is seen through the view as it is now.
render.unsupported: This browser cannot record video – save PNG images instead.

commands.render: Render the animation as a video
commands.shot: Show the animation panel and timeline

errors.keys: Keys are a list of [frame, value] (or [frame, value, curve])

script.animate: Keys a group or component at a frame: where its pivot is (at), its turn in degrees (rotate), its scale, whether it is visible, its colour and opacity – with a curve (interp). Returns its id.
script.animateKeys: Sets the keys of one channel at once – of a group, 'sun', { camera }, { light } or { material } – optionally repeated (cycle).
script.animatePath: Makes a group follow the lines of another group, from its start at frame `from` to its end at `to`, turned along it.
script.animateLookAt: Turns a group so its front always points at another one (null: no more).
script.animateCamera: A camera (made on first use of its name, with a shot if it is the first), keyed at a frame: position, target, lens; or looking at a group, or flying along a path. Returns its name.
script.animateShot: From this frame on the film is seen through that camera.
script.animateSun: The sun's hour (0 … 24) and the daylight (0 … 1) at a frame.
script.animateLight: A lamp or a spot (made on first use of its name), keyed at a frame: position, target, brightness, colour.
script.animateMaterial: A material's colour and opacity at a frame.
script.animateScene: The frame rate and the first and last frame; returns them.
script.animatePlay: Once the script is done: shows a frame, plays, looks through the camera.
script.animateRender: Once the script is done: renders the film as a video or PNG images.
script.animateClear: Removes a group's animation – or, without one, the whole animation.

showcase.name: A little film
showcase.description: A car on a winding road, a bouncing ball, a windmill, a sunset and two cameras that cut between each other.

robot.name: Robot arm
robot.description: Parts inside parts: each joint turns about its pivot and carries the rest along.

camera.name: Camera flight
camera.description: A camera flies along a curve around a house, looks at it and zooms in; the sun sets, a lamp goes on.

colors.name: Colours and fades
colors.description: Blocks pop up one after another, change colour in a wave and fade out; a glass pane frosts over.

guide.title: Animation guide
guide.heading: Your first animation
guide.intro: Step by step from a first movement to a film – each step ticks itself off once you have done it.

checks.atStart: The timeline is at the first frame
checks.later: The timeline is at a later frame

practice.title: Something to animate
practice.text: Animation moves groups and components. Load a practice scene with a box and a ball – or use your own model.

first.title: The first key
first.text: A key remembers where something is at a frame. Select the box, go to the first frame (the timeline under the 3D view) and press I.
first.done: The box has its first key – a diamond in the timeline.

second.title: A second key, somewhere else
second.text: Go to a later frame, move the box with the Move tool and press I again. Between the two keys the box moves by itself.
second.done: Two keys – the box moves between them.

play.title: Play it
play.text: Press Play (or Space while the mouse is over the timeline). Drag in the ruler of the timeline to see any frame.

graph.title: Smooth curves
graph.text: Switch the timeline to Graph: the movement as curves over time. Drag a key, right-click it for its curve – ease in and out, bounce, constant …

camera.title: A camera
camera.text: Turn the view to a nice angle and add a camera from it. 'Through camera' shows what it sees; move the view at another frame and key the camera again for a camera move.

render.title: The film
render.text: In the Film section of the Animation panel choose a size and render – as a video or as PNG images, at the frame rate set, however slow the computer is.

more.title: More to try
more.text: The demos show paths, parts inside parts, camera flights, the sun, lights and colours – open one in the script editor and run it.
